The version string is read from the FastAPI app instance (set in
``app.py::create_app`` from the canonical version-bump location) so a
release-time edit to ``FastAPI(version=...)`` propagates here without
a second hardcoded source of truth. Phase 8 hot-patch (was hardcoded
``"0.2.1"`` and silently drifted 5 releases — finding
UC1-health-version-stale).

Return the latest quote for one symbol.

``:path`` so a crypto pair (``BTC/USDT``, sent as ``BTC%2FUSDT``) routes —
Starlette decodes ``%2F`` before matching (R15-DATA-081). The blocking
provider call runs on a worker thread so a single-symbol request never
blocks the event loop. A ``ProviderError`` propagates to the app-level
handler.

Return latest quotes for a batch of symbols; failures are skipped.

Each symbol's blocking provider lookup runs on its own worker thread and all
of them are awaited concurrently. A single symbol's failure (any exception,
e.g. ``ProviderError``) is skipped, not fatal — matching the prior
sequential skip-on-failure semantics — so one bad symbol never aborts the
batch. ``return_exceptions=True`` keeps ``gather`` from short-circuiting on
the first failure; non-``Quote`` results (exceptions) are filtered out.

Each quote's ``symbol`` is the REQUESTED spelling (C14): a lane may answer
``RELIANCE`` for ``RELIANCE.NS``, and the client joins on what it asked for;
a requested symbol absent from the list is one that failed.

Return an OHLCV series for ``symbol`` at the requested timeframe.

Bug-2: if every provider returns an *empty* series (a transient gap, an
illiquid/newly-listed/delisted name — not a server fault), the correctness
gate raises :class:`EmptySeriesError`. We downgrade that one case to a clean
``200`` empty series so the chart renders its honest "No price data" state
instead of a scary ``(502)``. A genuine integrity failure (non-positive
close, symbol mismatch, no-provider) still propagates to the 502 handler.

post.description:
Run the screener and return the matching rows.

AND-combines every criterion. The universe is resolved on-the-fly
(custom universes use the request's ``custom_symbols``). Provider
failures during the fan-out are swallowed per-symbol so a single
upstream hiccup does not fail the whole run; if the universe itself
cannot be resolved the route returns 502. The whole run is bounded by
the engine's 120 s wall budget (R10/D40) — a starved run returns an
honest partial (``partial`` / ``coverage`` / ``budget_exhausted``
skips), never a multi-minute hang.

``ScreenerRequest.universe`` is required (no default), so the universe is
always explicit here. A caller that must *choose* a default reads it from
``GET /screener/default-universe`` (the panel adopts it on mount, FR-060).

Run the screener with live progress over SSE (R10, D40).

Frames are ``{"event":"progress",phase,done,total,detail}`` (mirrors
``ScreenerProgressFrame`` in ``types/screener.ts``) followed by one
``{"event":"result", …ScreenerResult}``. An engine crash emits one
``{"event":"error","message"}`` frame instead of the result (mirrors
``ScreenerErrorFrame``; the message is the unary route's error detail for a
ProviderError — or a sanitized one-liner, never raw
debug/provider output). The engine runs as a separate task; when the
client disconnects the generator is torn down and the task cancelled —
the engine catches the cancellation, finalizes an honest partial, and
stops (no orphaned sweep). The cancelled task is AWAITED before the
generator closes so a server shutdown never destroys a pending task.

Validate a custom screener formula (R7 Pillar 3).

The recovery-first inline-validation surface: a malformed formula is an
``ok: false`` body carrying the parser's message and 0-based caret
``position`` — never an HTTP error — so an editor or the agent can render
the ``^`` marker and self-correct. A valid formula returns the sorted
canonical fields it references.

bonus, split, rights issue or buyback, with its record/ex/payment dates.

CriterionGroup.title: CriterionGroup
CriterionGroup.description:
A boolean combinator node — AND/OR over leaf criteria or nested groups.

Enables OR + nested logic (e.g. ``(P/E < 15 AND ROE > 0.2) OR dividend_yield >
0.04``) beyond the flat AND-only ``criteria`` list. An EMPTY group matches
everything (no filter) regardless of combinator, mirroring the "no criteria =
show all" behaviour of the flat path. Recursive: a child may itself be a group.

CustomRuleError.description: One validation error with the rule it belongs to + caret position.

EarningsEstimateDetail.title: EarningsEstimateDetail
EarningsEstimateDetail.description: Detailed estimate breakdown for one upcoming earnings event.

EarningsEvent.title: EarningsEvent
EarningsEvent.description: One scheduled earnings event in the upcoming-calendar view.

EarningsHistoryEntry.title: EarningsHistoryEntry
EarningsHistoryEntry.description: One past earnings result in the symbol history grid.

EarningsSurprise.title: EarningsSurprise
EarningsSurprise.description: Actual reported result paired with the pre-report consensus estimate.

EquityCurvePoint.title: EquityCurvePoint
EquityCurvePoint.description: One point on the equity curve, sampled per bar.

ExchangeDeal.title: ExchangeDeal
ExchangeDeal.description:
One bulk deal, block deal or SAST (SEBI Reg 29) disclosure of an Indian
listing (R15-DATA-024). Fields a feed does not carry stay ``None``: bulk and
block deals carry no holding after; a SAST disclosure carries no price.

ExchangeDealsResponse.title: ExchangeDealsResponse
ExchangeDealsResponse.description: ``GET /disclosures/deals`` — bulk/block deals and SAST, newest first.

FieldMeta.title: FieldMeta
FieldMeta.description:
Per-field provenance / coverage metadata riding a :class:`Fundamentals`
payload (R13 data-bedrock).

One entry per data field the payload speaks to. ``status`` is one of:

  * ``"ok"`` — the field carries a real value the named provider served
    (``provider`` + ``as_of`` record who and when).
  * ``"flagged"`` — the value is KEPT but a cross-check disagrees with it;
    ``reason`` names the disagreement and the witness figure (e.g. the
    exchange shareholding, the payload-implied share count). Never a
    substitution — the served value stays the provider's own.
  * ``"withheld"`` — a value existed but the correctness gate NULLED it as
    implausible; ``reason`` says exactly why (e.g. an ownership fraction above
    1, an ambiguous-unit dividend yield). The field on the payload is ``None``.
  * ``"unavailable"`` — the source carried no value for the field.

``as_of`` is an ISO-8601 string (the provider's ``info`` fetch time for
yfinance). All fields beyond ``status`` are optional. The whole ``field_meta``
map is ADDITIVE — an absent map must never break an existing consumer.

Filing.title: Filing
Filing.description: Top-level filing metadata — one row in the filings list.

FilingDetail.title: FilingDetail
FilingDetail.description: Filing detail payload — what the FilingViewer panel renders.

FilingSection.title: FilingSection
FilingSection.description: One parsed section of a filing — e.g. ``"Item 1A. Risk Factors"``.

FiscalPeriod.title: FiscalPeriod
FiscalPeriod.description:
Fiscal-period label — e.g. ``"Q1 2026"``, ``"FY 2025"``.

Every ``fiscal_period`` field is ``None`` unless the provider supplies the
period — it is never inferred from a report date (R15-DATA-067).

FormulaValidation.title: FormulaValidation
FormulaValidation.description:
Response shape from ``POST /screener/formula/validate`` (R7 Pillar 3).

The inline-validation surface for the custom formula grammar
(:mod:`services.screener_formula`) — never a 4xx/5xx for a bad formula;
the error + 0-based caret ``position`` ride the body so an editor (or the
agent) can render `^` at the offending column.

Fundamentals.title: Fundamentals
Fundamentals.description:
Snapshot of valuation ratios, profitability, health, and profile for one
symbol. All new screener-grade fields are optional (``None`` when the source
does not carry them) so the panel renders a reason, never a fabricated value.

Units are documented per field: ``*_margin``/``roe``/``roa``/``*_growth``/
``held_percent_*``/``fifty_two_week_change`` are FRACTIONS (0.21 = 21%);
``dividend_yield`` is a fraction; ``debt_to_equity`` is a RATIO (yfinance's
percent form divided by 100, so 1.5 = 150%). ``currency`` is the TRADING
currency (prices, ``market_cap``, ``book_value``, ``eps``,
``dividend_per_share``); the statement-denominated sizes
(``revenue_ttm``/``net_income_ttm``/``free_cash_flow``) are in
``financial_currency`` when it is set (a foreign reporter such as an ADR),
else in ``currency``.

GreeksRequest.title: GreeksRequest
GreeksRequest.description: Subset of :class:`OptionPricingRequest` for the standalone Greeks endpoint.

GrowthQuarters.title: GrowthQuarters
GrowthQuarters.description:
The quarter-end pair (ISO dates) behind the computed growth cross-check
(R12 / D66) — MRQ vs the same quarter a year earlier.

IndicatorLine.title: IndicatorLine
IndicatorLine.description: One named line within an indicator (an indicator may plot several).

IndicatorPoint.title: IndicatorPoint
IndicatorPoint.description:
A single ``(time, value)`` sample on an indicator line.

``time`` is an ISO-8601 timestamp mirrored from the source OHLCV bar. A
``None`` value marks a gap where the indicator is undefined (e.g. the warm-up
window of a moving average).

IndicatorSeries.title: IndicatorSeries
IndicatorSeries.description: The full result of computing one indicator over an OHLCV series.

IndividualAnalystForecast.title: IndividualAnalystForecast
IndividualAnalystForecast.description: One analyst's active forecast + historical accuracy where exposed.

InsiderTransaction.title: InsiderTransaction
InsiderTransaction.description: One insider transaction row from a Form 3 / 4 / 5 filing.

IntervalTrigger.title: IntervalTrigger
IntervalTrigger.description: Fire every ``every_minutes`` (>= 5) after the last fire (or creation).

LLMChatRequest.title: LLMChatRequest
LLMChatRequest.description:
``POST /llm/chat`` request body.

``api_key`` is BYOK — read from the OS keychain on the frontend and passed
per request. The sidecar holds it in memory only for the lifetime of the
request; never persisted, never logged.

LLMKeyValidationResponse.title: LLMKeyValidationResponse
LLMKeyValidationResponse.description: Validation result — sidecar performs a cheap GET against the provider.

LLMMessage.title: LLMMessage
LLMMessage.description: One message in a chat conversation; mirrors OpenAI/Anthropic shape.

LLMModelCatalog.title: LLMModelCatalog
LLMModelCatalog.description:
``GET /llm/models`` payload — a provider's live (or fallback) model list.

``source`` is ``"live"`` when the provider's catalog API answered and
``"fallback"`` when we served the registry ``known_models`` because the live
fetch failed or returned nothing. ``note`` is a short honest line for the UI
(e.g. "routable on your key · 247 tool-capable" or "live catalog
unavailable"). Read-only; carries no credential.

LLMModelOption.title: LLMModelOption
LLMModelOption.description:
One model in a LIVE provider catalog (``GET /llm/models``).

Richer than the bare ``known_models`` string list: carries the metadata the
model picker needs to mark a model — most importantly ``supports_tools`` so
the agent surface can flag a model that would break host-actions (the whole
point of the OpenRouter live-catalog fix). All fields beyond ``id``/``label``
are best-effort: ``None`` means "the provider's catalog did not say", never
"false".

LLMProviderInfo.title: LLMProviderInfo
LLMProviderInfo.description: One row in ``GET /llm/providers`` — what the chat sidebar enumerates.

MacroCatalogEntry.title: MacroCatalogEntry
MacroCatalogEntry.description: One entry in a provider's curated catalog.

MacroObservation.title: MacroObservation
MacroObservation.description: One dated observation within a macro series.

MacroSeriesExtended.title: MacroSeriesExtended

MajorShareholder.title: MajorShareholder
MajorShareholder.description: One 5%-or-more holder from a foreign issuer's 20-F (Item 7.A).

NewsItem.title: NewsItem
NewsItem.description: A single news article, optionally tagged with symbols and sentiment.

NodePosition.title: NodePosition
NodePosition.description: Canvas position — node-editor only; engine ignores.

NumericRange.title: NumericRange
NumericRange.description: Inclusive numeric range for the ``between`` operator.

OHLCVSeries.title: OHLCVSeries
OHLCVSeries.description: An ordered series of OHLCV bars for one symbol and timeframe.

OptionChain.title: OptionChain
OptionChain.description:
One expiry of a symbol's listed option chain, as the source published it.

Research data only (D81): exchange-published EOD OI and prices, never a
trading surface. ``as_of`` is the session the values describe.

OptionContract.title: OptionContract
OptionContract.description: One listed option contract's end-of-day row in an option chain (R15-DATA-079).

PluginConfigPayload.title: PluginConfigPayload
PluginConfigPayload.description: Per-plugin persisted config — mirrors ``PluginPersistedConfig`` in TS.

PluginConfigUpdate.title: PluginConfigUpdate
PluginConfigUpdate.description: PUT/POST body for updating a plugin's config (id comes from the URL).

Position.title: Position
Position.description: A single held position, persisted in the local SQLite database.

PriceTargetEntry.title: PriceTargetEntry
PriceTargetEntry.description: One row in a symbol's price-target-history timeline.

ProviderDeclarationOut.title: ProviderDeclarationOut
ProviderDeclarationOut.description: One provider's served model-keys + scope, as reported to the frontend.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: A point-in-time price quote for one instrument.

RatingsHistoryEntry.title: RatingsHistoryEntry
RatingsHistoryEntry.description: One row in a symbol's ratings-history timeline.

ResultsEvent.title: ResultsEvent
ResultsEvent.description:
One results-calendar / board-meeting event (NSE event-calendar feed,
BSE board-meeting feed).

RunBudget.title: RunBudget
RunBudget.description:
The hard spend ceilings for a Delegate run (US9 / FR-026).

A request may omit any ceiling; ``run_manager`` fills every omitted one from
:data:`DEFAULT_RUN_BUDGET` before the run starts, so a run is never
unbounded (R15-AGENT-034). A given ceiling must be positive. The
:class:`~services.budget_guard.BudgetGuard` aborts the run on the FIRST
breach with a stated reason (SC-008: a breach aborts 100% of the time).
The guard governs SPEND only; a Delegate run uses the same agent loop, in
which no trading path exists.

RunLaunchRequest.title: RunLaunchRequest
RunLaunchRequest.description:
``POST /agents/{agent_id}/runs`` request body.

``api_key`` is BYOK — it crosses for the lifetime of THIS run only and is
never stored in the runs database, never logged, never echoed back in any
response (asserted in ``test_runs_router``).

SaveWorkspaceRequest.title: SaveWorkspaceRequest
SaveWorkspaceRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /workspace``: a name plus the opaque workspace JSON.

``workspace`` is free-form — the sidecar persists it without interpreting
it. The frontend puts the dockview layout and the modules ``enabled`` map in
there; the contract for that shape lives in ``src/lib/workspace.ts``.

SavedWorkflows.title: SavedWorkflows
SavedWorkflows.description: ``GET /workflow/saved`` — the openable specs plus the rows that are not.

ScreenerResultRow.title: ScreenerResultRow
ScreenerResultRow.description: One row in the screener results table.

ScreenerUniverse.title: ScreenerUniverse
ScreenerUniverse.description: A universe definition the screener fans out across.

SetInCriterion.title: SetInCriterion
SetInCriterion.description: ``in`` against a set of string values.

ShareholdingPattern.title: ShareholdingPattern
ShareholdingPattern.description:
One quarterly shareholding-pattern row for a listed company.

Percentages are 0-100 (as the exchanges publish them). ``fii_percent`` /
``dii_percent`` are ``None`` when the source feed does not carry the split
(the NSE master does not — the linked XBRL filing does); they are never
fabricated.

ShareholdingResponse.title: ShareholdingResponse
ShareholdingResponse.description:
``GET /disclosures/shareholding`` — quarterly patterns, newest first.

A US-listed ADR has no Indian shareholding pattern; its major holders come
from its latest 20-F as a separate, disclosed lane (``provider`` =
``"sec-20f"``, ``major_shareholders``), never merged into ``patterns``.

SkipDetail.title: SkipDetail
SkipDetail.description:
One itemized skip — a universe member that never reached evaluation.

The R4 batch fast path (FR-126 / SC-034) replaced the old "silently drop
242/506" behaviour with a complete ledger: every symbol the screener could
not evaluate is itemized here with a machine-readable ``reason`` so the UI
can surface coverage honestly. ``skipped_count == len(skip_details)`` always.

``reason`` is one of:
  - ``"timeout"`` — the upstream fetch (batch chunk or per-symbol) timed out.
  - ``"not_found"`` — Yahoo did not return a row for the symbol.
  - ``"no_data"`` — a row came back but carried no usable price / payload.
  - ``"rate_limited"`` — the upstream throttled the request (HTTP 429).
  - ``"correctness_gate"`` — the provider raised a ``ProviderError`` (a
    deliberate refusal to fabricate a value).
  - ``"missing_field:<field>"`` — a criterion or the custom ``formula``
    referenced a field neither the batch row nor the per-symbol enrichment
    could supply for this symbol.

StatementLine.title: StatementLine
StatementLine.description: One labelled row of a financial statement, keyed by period label.

StringEqCriterion.title: StringEqCriterion
StringEqCriterion.description: ``= `` against a string field — sector / industry / currency.

UnreadableWorkflow.title: UnreadableWorkflow
UnreadableWorkflow.description: A saved row this build cannot open (invalid spec or another major).

UnverifiedClaim.title: UnverifiedClaim
UnverifiedClaim.description:
One numeric figure in the LLM narrative that did NOT match the source data.

The narrative service extracts every numeric claim from the model's output
and matches each against the real fundamentals/quote it was given. A claim
that matches no source value (a likely hallucination) is recorded here and
REDACTED from the prose before it reaches the UI — a fabricated figure must
never render as fact.

VolumeProfile.title: VolumeProfile
VolumeProfile.description:
A horizontal-histogram Volume Profile — a price-axis distribution.

Returned as a top-level field on :class:`IndicatorResponse` rather than
inside the per-indicator ``IndicatorSeries`` list because its axes are
fundamentally different (price-keyed, not time-keyed).

VolumeProfileBucket.title: VolumeProfileBucket
VolumeProfileBucket.description:
One price-bucket of a Volume Profile histogram.

``price`` is the bucket centre (a true float, not a label string), and
``volume`` is the total traded volume that closed inside that bucket.

WebhookRefs.title: WebhookRefs
WebhookRefs.description: ``GET /workflow/webhooks`` — the refs with a URL held in memory (never the URLs).

WorkflowEdge.title: WorkflowEdge
WorkflowEdge.description: An edge connecting two nodes' ports.

WorkflowNode.title: WorkflowNode
WorkflowNode.description: A node in a workflow graph.

WorkflowSchedule.title: WorkflowSchedule
WorkflowSchedule.description: One persisted schedule plus its last outcome.

WorkflowSpec.title: WorkflowSpec
WorkflowSpec.description: A complete workflow — the unit of save / load / run.

YieldCurveInstrument.title: YieldCurveInstrument
YieldCurveInstrument.description: One instrument used to bootstrap a yield curve.

YieldCurvePoint.title: YieldCurvePoint
YieldCurvePoint.description: One sampled point on a bootstrapped curve.

YieldCurveRequest.title: YieldCurveRequest
YieldCurveRequest.description: Bootstrap a yield curve from the given instruments.
